name: mt_bench_answers_vanilla
description: A collection of model-generated answers in the MT-Bench 'vanilla' format intended for benchmarking LLM response quality across diverse instruction prompts. Useful for pairwise and human-preference evaluations as well as automated post-hoc analyses of response quality and consistency.
evaluation_method: human_eval (pairwise preference / win-rate) typically used for MT-Bench-style comparisons
reputation: Used by the MT-Bench community and downstream evaluators as a convenient corpus of model answers; moderately adopted for comparative evaluation.
